# RESTRICTED OUTREACH

> B2B consultancy connecting AI strategy at scale and development with Lovable and agentic Claude.

- [AI Strategy](https://www.restrictedoutreach.com/strategy): Diagnosis, roadmap, governance, adoption and scaling.
- [Development](https://www.restrictedoutreach.com/services/development): Applications with Lovable and agents with Claude, integrations, testing and support.
- [3A Method](https://www.restrictedoutreach.com/method): Friction audit, invisible architecture and supported adoption.
- [Diagnosis](https://www.restrictedoutreach.com/diagnosis): Two-hour workshop after a fit conversation.
- [About](https://www.restrictedoutreach.com/about): Consultancy in Sant Cugat del Vallès, Barcelona.
- [Contact](https://www.restrictedoutreach.com/contact): Discuss an AI challenge or development project.

People first, existing-tool integration, human review and measurable impact. Full methodology: six weeks. Separately scoped single-process pilot: thirty days. Quotes personalized; ROI not guaranteed.
